name: CRUD list
descriptor: One entity, one list, one form. The shape every small app starts from: contacts, inventory, issues, tickets.
verify_checks: no file changed (golden, when a baseline exists)
pros: the fastest shape to build and to use
one form, one list, nothing to learn
search and sort come free from the runtime
prints and exports without extra work
cons: linear search: fine to a few thousand rows, slow beyond
no relations, so a second entity needs a second app
one view, so comparison across records is manual
best_for: a single flat list of records that one person maintains
avoid_if: records point at other records, or the app needs two lists at once
